basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old tech enthusiast and casual gamer based in Denver, Colorado. By day, I work as an IT support specialist, helping people solve their tech woes. In my free time, I enjoy diving into online gaming, particularly strategy games like Clash of Clans, and exploring virtual worlds in GTA IV. I also have a deep interest in urban cultures, which has recently led me to learn more about cities like Guangzhou. I'm single, and I usually spend my evenings and weekends engaging with online communities or learning about new gaming mods. I have a growing interest in the economics of gaming, especially the controversial world of scalping.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in IT, with a degree in Information Technology from a local university. My gaming knowledge is mostly self-taught, acquired through years of playing various titles and participating in online forums and communities. I also have a newfound interest in urban studies, sparked by my travels and online research.
